name: Connected Apps Platform
desc: One place to build apps for Google Search and Gemini
desc_zh: 统一为 Google 搜索和 Gemini 开发应用的平台
solves: App actions were built separately for Search and Gemini; one platform now manages both and their app listings.
solves_zh: 过去要分别为搜索和 Gemini 开发应用动作，现在一个平台统一管理和上架。
best_for: Your booking site already supports App Links and you want bookings to work inside Gemini.
best_for_zh: 预订网站已支持应用深链，想让用户直接在 Gemini 里完成预订。
